d:
Watch 'Dandanakka' from the movie Romeo Juliet, sung by Anirudh Ravichander. Composer D. Imman gives us one massive kuthu number that is sure to top the dance charts. With lyrics by G. Rokesh this song is a party in itself!
Song Name - Dandanakka
Movie - Romeo Juliet
Singer - Anirudh Ravichander
Music - D. Imman
Lyrics - G. Rokesh
Director - Lakshman
Starring - Jayam Ravi, Hansika Motwani
